scope: BLOCK_CAROUSEL_STRUCTURE source-add selection subset: native caption edit, source batch or one URL/HTML append, and two native Undo/Redo actions with fixed mixed-media neighbors.

historicalDifferences.detail: All three append paths select the first new slide. Their subsequent native shortcuts target BODY and do not replay history; nine raw record mismatches remain visible. No fixture refocus is used.
All three append paths keep the original slide active, producing six counter/caption mismatches. Their native history sequences pass.

controls.listenerNavigation: Synchronous publishing callbacks may observe the new slide but may not call public focus. The final control queues the newer navigation in a microtask; the completed source does not overwrite it.
controls.staleTask: Remove all aborts the delayed source. After native Undo and newer navigation to Bravo, late completion neither appends nor selects a slide.
controls.canonicalRecovery: Controlled failure after the actual added-slide projection retires the old owner and restores original records, initial Alpha view and public Undo/Redo. This does not prove arbitrary prior-view or native-keyboard recovery.
controls.settingsTarget: A native manual settings selection of Bravo is replaced by Delta when an accepted source navigates to Delta. Ordinary metadata updates retain their existing selection behavior.

retainedFailedExploration.initialControls: One attempted synchronous publishing-phase focus was an invalid fixture expectation. A separate native Undo failure after canonical recovery is a real diagnostic retained verbatim; it is not labeled green or repaired by this Carousel patch.
retainedFailedExploration.recoveryFollowup: The independent core owner is investigating recovery keyboard focus. The final Carousel recovery assertion is explicitly limited to canonical history and remount, with its original native failure archived.

notClaimed: Detailed remove/reorder coverage beyond the unchanged affected page

reproduction: The exact one-off probe and gate runner are archived. Their absolute checkout, dependency and browser paths describe the executed environment; preserve those mounts or adapt paths explicitly. Source SHAs and loaded-byte hashes remain mandatory.
